title: Consolidated model-route latency matrix with streaming vs non-streaming breakdowns
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Build a single Grafana/Console dashboard that surfaces per-model and per-route latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) with an explicit breakdown between streaming (server-sent chunks) and non-streaming (sync/batched) request modes. The dashboard should: 1) provide a compact matrix view for quick comparison across model+route pairs; 2) enable time-series drilldowns for any cell showing trend lines and error rates; 3) link to traces (Tempo/Jaeger) and relevant logs for tail-latency investigation; 4) include KV-cache hit/miss splits and request-size buckets to help attribute tail latency causes. This ticket covers instrumentation additions, metrics pipeline rollups, dashboard panels, and follow-up QA and runbook updates.
comments: 2026-02-15 - Ava Thompson: Initial proposal posted. Goal is to replace several small latency panels with a consolidated, actionable matrix. Raised concern about cardinality explosion if we include client_id and tenant labels. Proposed primary dims: model.name, route.name, request.mode (streaming|sync|batch). Optional dims (tagged): kv_cache_hit, quantization_profile.

2026-02-17 - Ravi Patel: Architecture notes - will emit OTEL histogram metrics for request latency with attributes: model.name, route.name, request.mode, kv_cache_hit, token_count_bucket. Backend will pre-aggregate minute rollups into ClickHouse to avoid Prometheus series explosion. We agreed on 1m rollups and 30d retention for rollups, 90d for raw errors traces.

2026-02-18 - Maya Chen (PM): Please make sure the dashboard exposes a toggle to view streaming partial-chunk latencies vs final-chunk only. Product needs to correlate partial-chunk delay patterns to user-visible latency spikes.

2026-02-20 - Design review (Sasha Ruiz): UX suggestion - matrix cells should show p95 as primary number, p50/p99 on hover, and a small sparkline. Add vertical heatmap option to highlight models with high tail latency. Approved the mockups in the design doc.

2026-02-22 - Ravi Patel: Instrumentation PR opened - adds otel histogram buckets + trace propagation for stream-chunk spans. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4321. Notes: opted for adaptive bucketing to limit metric cardinality; will tag high-cardinality labels as 'meta' (not in rollups) and emit to logs only.

2026-02-24 - QA (Diego Martinez): Ran load test with mixed streaming and non-streaming traffic. Observed expected separation of streaming partial-chunk p95; however, tail latency spikes correlate with KV-cache miss rate >30% for model-x routes. Created follow-up ENG ticket to improve cache priming heuristics.
2026-02-26 - Security (Priya Nair): Reviewed trace propagation changes; recommended masking user-identifiable attributes before writing to Tempo. Updated the instrumentation checklist accordingly.

2026-02-28 - Ravi Patel: Dashboard panels implemented and flagged for UX polish. Next steps: finalize rollup queries, add trace link context preservation (trace_id propagation), and prepare runbook entry for oncall. Targeting release console-2026.03.
next_steps: Finalize ClickHouse rollup queries and test queries against 30d historical dataset
Add trace link embedding to each matrix cell (pass trace_id and representative span)
Adjust Grafana visuals per Sasha's mockups and add heatmap toggle
Deploy instrumentation changes to staging and run targeted load tests (stream-heavy mix)
Publish runbook and announce to SRE and Platform teams
